title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hooks and metrics gating
author: Maya Chen
body:
Motivation: Add a CI hook in the eval-harness pipeline that runs prompt-set based regression checks on PRs touching model-serving or eval-related code. This prevents accidental quality regressions when changing tokenization, preprocessing, or model routing logic.

What this PR does: 1) Introduces a new GitHub Actions job (eval/prompt-regression) that runs a lightweight subset of the eval-harness prompt sets against a pinned baseline and computes evaluation metrics (BLEU-like score, semantic similarity, task-specific pass rates). 2) Adds a configurable gating step that compares current run metrics against stored baselines (in /ci/baselines/) and fails the check when regressions exceed thresholds. 3) Uploads artifacts (raw outputs, diffs, metric report) for triage and links them in the check summary. 4) Adds a small test harness and unit tests for the gating comparator library. 5) Adds docs for signal interpretation and how to update baselines when behaviour changes intentionally.

Checklist: - [x] Core job + gating comparator implemented - [x] Baseline format and storage implemented - [x] Unit tests for comparator and CI shim - [x] E2E smoke job runs in GitHub Actions - [x] Docs section added to docs/eval-harness/ci.md - [x] Follow-up Linear ticket created for expanding prompt coverage (ENG-4220)

Backward compatibility: gating is opt-in by label for now (label: eval-regress-gate). Default behavior is non-blocking for most repos; redwood core enabling is behind a feature flag in .github/workflows/eval.yml.

Notes on thresholds: thresholds chosen after running historical runs from the last 90 days and inspecting noise distribution per-metric. Thresholds are documented in /ci/baselines/README.md. Maintainers can raise a Linear ticket if a known change requires baseline update.

Operational details: The job uses a cached docker image with eval-harness binaries and pulls preserved baselines from a hashed path keyed by model+prompt-set+commit. Artifacts are stored as job outputs and linked to the PR. The comparator emits structured summary lines that are surfaceable in the GH check annotation (short summary + top-3 failing prompts).

Follow-ups: ENG-4220 (increase prompt coverage), ENG-4250 (add alerting to Console for CI regressions), QA-90 (owner runbook).
commits:
1) Add prompt-regression GH Action and comparator library
2) Add baseline storage and example baselines
3) Add unit tests and small smoke harness
4) Update docs and README
(4 commits, squashed on merge)
review_comments: Aisha Verma (reviewer): Can we make the comparator tolerant to small sample-size noise? Suggest adding a minimum sample-size guard and a bootstrap CI for confidence intervals.
Maya Chen (author): Added min_sample_size=30 guard and a bootstrap-based confidence interval in comparator; updated tests to cover small-sample case.
Benji Park (reviewer): The action runtime looks like ~12m in my run - can we cache the docker image by digest? Also flagging that artifacts can grow large; suggest gzipping raw outputs.
Maya Chen (author): Switched to image by digest and gzip artifacts; reduced artifact retention to 7 days by default in workflow config.
Carlos Medina (approver): Approve after addressing Aisha/Benji's comments and adding docs for baseline update process.
ci_checks: eval/prompt-regression: fail (initial) - regression on semantic-similarity exceeded threshold for 2 prompts
eval/prompt-regression: pass (after baseline adjustment and commit)
release_notes: Add CI hook for prompt-set regression checks in eval-harness; introduces baseline storage, comparator tooling, and docs for interpreting CI signals.
